name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Smooth Spiced Pumpkin Pie (Costco or Homemade)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Bakery / Thanksgiving & Christmas Dessert Table
whyItWorks: The #1 Crohn's-friendly holiday pie: puréed pumpkin custard baked in a refined white pastry crust is 100% smooth, seedless, nut-free, and rich in soluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a slice of Pumpkin Pie with dairy-free CocoWhip/Cool Whip (or take a Lactaid for the evaporated milk in the custard and whipped cream).
watchOuts: Contains evaporated milk in the custard—pair with a Lactaid if lactose-sensitive
